summary: st-test's megarepo member step now takes the end of its build-admission wait from the gate's own notice instead of only sampling its process every half second. It names a pipe in BUILD_ADMISSION_NOTIFY_FD, and the gate writes 'admitted <time> <waited>' there just before it execs the command (#5069). The line ends the wait when it arrives, and the wait is at least the gate's figure, so a short admission between two samples is no longer charged as running. Hosts whose gate does not write the notice keep the /proc sample.

replay.detail: No stored data is read or written differently.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet coordination version change.

compatibility.detail: scripts/st-test only: the member step's command gets BUILD_ADMISSION_NOTIFY_FD and one inherited pipe fd. A gate without the notice ignores both, and the step then falls back to the process sample of #5068.
